items.name: Blunt
items.use_message: You light up and take a long drag... The world feels a little more chill.
items.description: A hand-rolled herbal smoke. Relaxing.

items.name: Basic Worm
items.description: A fat, wriggling worm. The old reliable for any angler.

items.name: Enchanted Grub
items.description: Pulsing with faint magic. Attracts rarer fish from the deep.

items.name: Abyssal Lure
items.description: Forged from deep-sea coral. Even legendary fish can't resist its call.

items.name: Iron Rod
items.description: A sturdy iron rod. Each reel tap pulls 1.5× harder than a bare line.

items.name: Mithril Rod
items.description: Lightweight and impossibly strong. Each reel tap pulls 2× harder.

items.name: Dragonbone Rod
items.description: Carved from the spine of a wyrm. Each reel tap pulls 3× harder. The finest rod in Okhan.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A small vial of red liquid that shimmers when agitated. Restores 2d4+2 HP.

items.name: Potion of Greater Healing
items.description: A larger flask of deep crimson liquid. Restores 4d4+4 HP.

items.name: Potion of Superior Healing
items.description: A crystal bottle of radiant scarlet elixir. Restores 8d4+8 HP.

items.name: Midnight Dice
items.description: Pure black with stark white numbering. Simple. Timeless.

items.name: Ivory Dice
items.description: Polished white bone with clean edges. The scholar's choice.

items.name: Ember Dice
items.description: Forged in dragonfire. Deep reds and oranges with flickering embers.

items.name: Frostbite Dice
items.description: Carved from enchanted ice. Deep blue with a crystalline shimmer.

items.name: Venom Dice
items.description: Infused with basilisk venom. Dark purple with cloudy toxic swirls.

items.name: Corrosive Dice
items.description: Etched by ooze. Vivid green with a marbled acid-wash sheen.

items.name: Lightning Dice
items.description: Charged by storm giants. Amber and gold with crackling frost-lines.

items.name: Thunder Dice
items.description: Rumbling stormcloud gray with golden numbering. You hear distant thunder.

items.name: Zephyr Dice
items.description: Light as a breeze. Pale blue wisps swirl through cloudy resin.

items.name: Tidal Dice
items.description: Pulled from the deep. Ocean teal with the shimmer of moving water.

items.name: Earthen Dice
items.description: Hewn from living stone. Deep greens and browns with speckled grain.

items.name: Bronze Dice
items.description: Cast in ancient Thylean bronze. A warrior's classic.

items.name: Radiant Dice
items.description: Blessed by the dawn. Pure white with golden numbering that catches the light.

items.name: Necrotic Dice
items.description: Carved from bone and shadow. Blood-dark crimson etched with tiny skulls.

items.name: Force Dice
items.description: Pure magical energy given form. Hot pink and violet shimmer with starlight.

items.name: Psychic Dice
items.description: They seem to shift when you're not looking. Deep indigo with neon purple speckles.

items.name: Bardic Dice
items.description: Warm parchment tones with golden ink. Roll with inspiration.

items.name: Prismatic Dice
items.description: Every face a different hue. Like rolling a tiny rainbow across the table.

items.name: Golden Dice
items.description: Pure gold with polished faces. For those who spare no expense.

items.name: Breebaby Dice
items.description: Pastel sunset swirls in pink, lavender, and soft blue marble. Deceptively cute.

items.name: Glitter Party Dice
items.description: A chaotic explosion of pink, blue, and purple glitter. Party time.

items.name: Pink Dreams Dice
items.description: Hot pink and magenta with tiny skull engravings. Sweet dreams aren't made of these.

items.name: Blood Moon Dice
items.description: Dark crimson marble with gold numbering. Roll under a blood-red sky.

items.name: Starry Night Dice
items.description: Deep midnight blue fading to silver. Like holding the night sky in your hand.

items.name: Astral Sea Dice
items.description: Pearlescent white with swirling astral patterns. Plucked from another plane.

items.name: Phoenix Dice
items.description: Vivid plumage colors — scarlet, gold, emerald, cerulean. Rise from the ashes.

items.name: Tiger King Dice
items.description: Bold gold with wild animal-print patterns. Exotic and unapologetic.

items.name: Dragon Dice
items.description: Each die bears a different dragon's scale. Chromatic chaos in your palm.

items.name: Obsidian Dice
items.description: Dark as the void with a faint glitter. For those who walk in shadow.

items.name: Custom Emoji
items.description: A custom server emoji made just for you. DM The Architect to discuss your idea.
